mapper.insert: insert into task_management ( task_name, selected_data, dataset_ids_json, runtime_image_id, resource_overrides_json, execution_mode, acceptance_run_id, run_round, status, create_time, T1, T2, rating, schedule, data_preparation_ms, compute_duration_ms, execution_evidence_complete, started_at, finished_at ) values ( #{taskName}, #{selectedData}, #{datasetIdsJson}, #{runtimeImageId}, #{resourceOverridesJson}, #{executionMode}, #{acceptanceRunId}, #{runRound}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{T1}, #{T2}, #{rating}, #{schedule}, #{dataPreparationMs}, #{computeDurationMs}, COALESCE(#{executionEvidenceComplete}, 0), #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt} )
mapper.select:
select * from task_management where 1=1
and ( task_id like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or status like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or selected_data like concat('%', #{query}, '%') )
SELECT (latency + (#{dataSize} / bandwidth)) AS t2 FROM edge_management WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND target_id = 1 ORDER BY latency + (#{dataSize} / bandwidth) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT target_id AS nodeId FROM edge_management WHERE source_id = #{nodeId} AND target_id IN (SELECT node_id FROM node_management WHERE type = '计算节点') ORDER BY (latency + (#{dataSize} / bandwidth)) ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update:
UPDATE task_management SET
task_name = #{taskName},
T1 = #{T1}, T2 = #{T2}, rating = #{rating}, schedule = #{schedule}, status = #{status}, data_preparation_ms = COALESCE(#{dataPreparationMs}, data_preparation_ms), compute_duration_ms = COALESCE(#{computeDurationMs}, compute_duration_ms), execution_evidence_complete = COALESCE(#{executionEvidenceComplete}, execution_evidence_complete), started_at = COALESCE(#{startedAt}, started_at), finished_at = COALESCE(#{finishedAt}, finished_at)
WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_execution_event ( task_id, dataset_id, execution_mode, event_type, occurred_at, job_name, pod_name, node_name, input_path, bytes_processed, checksum_sha256, duration_ms, output_summary, output_checksum_sha256, attempt, details_json ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{datasetId}, #{executionMode}, #{eventType}, #{occurredAt}, #{jobName}, #{podName}, #{nodeName}, #{inputPath}, #{bytesProcessed}, #{checksumSha256}, #{durationMs}, #{outputSummary}, #{outputChecksumSha256}, #{attempt}, #{detailsJson} )
mapper.select:
SELECT tm.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scheduling_plan sp WHERE sp.internal_task_id = tm.task_id) AS manual_schedule FROM task_management tm WHERE tm.schedule IS NOT NULL AND tm.schedule != ''
AND tm.task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
ORDER BY tm.create_time ASC

SELECT tm.* FROM task_management tm WHERE tm.T1 IS NOT NULL AND tm.T2 IS NOT NULL AND tm.rating IS NOT NULL
AND ( tm.schedule IS NULL OR LOCATE('中心化调度方案:', tm.schedule) = 0 OR TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tm.schedule, '中心化调度方案:', -1)) != '' )
AND tm.task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
ORDER BY tm.create_time ASC
